metadata.prompt: Produce a character design turnaround sheet on a plain white background showing three full-body views of the character from the supplied image side by side: front view, profile side view, and back view. Preserve the exact identity, facial features, hairstyle, clothing, body proportions, materials, color grading and art style of the supplied image. Neutral A-pose, head-to-toe full length visible in all three views. Clothing, accessories, footwear and hairstyle must be identical across every angle. Flat diffused neutral studio lighting with soft shadows. No cast shadows, no environment, no props. Do not add text, captions, watermarks, logos or frame borders.
